items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So was Ernst, and Ernst still, a very good friend. We did it and said, why don’t we play together? So that’s how we started, 2005.

ctx.x: No, but his friend [?Ernst Bucher]. That’s the – they come together. That’s right, because that’s the same town. They’re like next to each other.
I just got an e-mail from Jurg yesterday.
